name: @pipeworx/mcp-edamam

tools.name: nutrition_analysis
tools.description: Analyze the nutrition of a food ingredient or recipe line and return calories, weight, diet/health labels, and a macro breakdown. Example: nutrition_analysis({ ingredient: "1 cup rice and 10 oz chickpeas" })

ingredient.description: Free-text ingredient or recipe line, e.g. "1 large apple", "100g cheddar cheese", "1 cup cooked rice"

_apiKey.description: Optional Edamam credentials (comma-separated nutrition,recipe,food pairs of app_id:app_key). Omit to use the platform key.

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Search Edamam's recipe database by keyword with optional diet, health, and cuisine filters. Returns recipes with calories, time, servings, and ingredient lists. Example: search_recipes({ query: "chicken curry", health: "gluten-free", limit: 5 })

query.description: Recipe search keywords, e.g. "chicken curry", "vegan brownies"

_apiKey.description: Optional Edamam credentials (comma-separated nutrition,recipe,food pairs of app_id:app_key). Omit to use the platform key.

tools.name: search_food
tools.description: Search Edamam's food database for foods matching a query and return per-100g macros (calories, protein, fat, carbs). Example: search_food({ query: "cheddar cheese", limit: 10 })

query.description: Food name to search for, e.g. "cheddar cheese", "banana", "almond milk"

_apiKey.description: Optional Edamam credentials (comma-separated nutrition,recipe,food pairs of app_id:app_key). Omit to use the platform key.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-edamam forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the edamam pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
